answer: Each agent binds to one enclave chip whose ferrous seal fuses chip serial to key, so a copied credential cannot run elsewhere. Enrolment signs a fresh branch of the yarrow challenge tree and starts a monotonic counter; each attestation becomes a new shale layer, so reuse prints the same counter twice. The k-th fake still needs a k-th chip plus 80 credits of bond, since counters and seals cannot be shared; 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 80 once. Chip rental fails: a counter jumping between owners freezes both identities and burns the bond.
